Is TRACE IT AI generated?

HuntForgeOct 25, 2026Steam page ↗

Music was made with Suno, some visual assets used AI image generation, and AI helped with code brainstorming and debugging; nothing is generated live.

The disclosure hedges how much was made with AI ("some", "certain assets").

What the developer wrote

AI Generated Content Disclosure The developers of LIGHT IT provide the following disclosure regarding the use of AI tools in the creation of this game. All AI-assisted content is pre-generated; the game does not generate any AI content live during gameplay. Music: The in-game music was produced using Suno, an AI music-generation tool. Art: Some visual assets were created with the assistance of AI image-generation tools. Code: AI assistants were used to help brainstorm implementation ideas and to assist with debugging. All AI-assisted content and code was reviewed, tested, and refined by the developer before being included in the final game.
